title: Power Rankings: Clippers climb, Minny makes move, Lakers leap, Rockets rise
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 6

rankings.summaryHtml: Pistons might well reside in the league's toughest division. Yet even in the Central, can you say that any team is close to them right now?

rankings.summaryHtml: Mavs just keep picking up injuries and racking up victories. They've also already beaten just about every team in the league playing well these days.

rankings.summaryHtml: Remember a week or so ago when Pop said it's too early in such a long season ''to go after these guys'' like he wants to? Just a hunch, but it'll be harder for Pop to hold back after going to lowly Atlanta and losing.

rankings.summaryHtml: Sad but true: More than anyone else in the East, Wiz have left me wanting more. They've teased us twice -- looking so good vs. Spurs and Pistons -- but more regularly have fallen shy of their potential . . . even without the departed Hughes.
